title: Valparaíso Rising
author: Ines Yarrow
blurb: Xanthe Nakamura, a pearl diver's child indentured to a trading company, has spent fifteen years learning which silences keep people safe. Then the army requisitions the town and the ledger with all the names — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must smuggle the evidence past three checkpoints, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
